title: Assemble Your Crew: Automatic Multi-agent Communication Topology Design via Autoregressive Graph Generation
authors: Shiyuan Li; Yixin Liu; Qingsong Wen; Chengqi Zhang; Shirui Pan
affiliations: Griffith University (Shiyuan Li, Yixin Liu, Shirui Pan [corresponding]);

problem_statement.en: The effectiveness of LLM-based multi-agent systems hinges on the communication topology, yet prior methods either use fixed hand-crafted topologies or only prune/edit a pre-defined fully-connected graph, which fixes the agent count and roles up front and constrains the design space. The paper asks how to build the collaboration graph — number of agents, their roles, and their communication links — entirely from scratch and adapt it to each individual natural-language task query.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 LLM 的 multi-agent 系統其效能取決於通訊拓撲,然而既有方法或採用固定的手工設計拓撲,或僅對預先定義的全連接圖進行剪枝與編輯,此類做法在事前即固定了 agent 數量與角色,並限縮了設計空間。本文探討如何從零開始建構協作圖——即 agent 數量、各自角色及其通訊連結——並使其能針對每一項個別的自然語言任務 query 進行調適。

key_innovation.en: It reframes MAS topology design as conditional autoregressive graph generation: a generative model conditioned on the task query builds the graph node-by-node (selecting each agent's role from an extensible embedding pool and emitting an END token to decide the agent count) and edge-by-edge, trained end-to-end with a dense-to-sparse (exploration then efficiency) curriculum so topologies are both correct and token-efficient.
key_innovation.zh: 本文將 MAS 拓撲設計重新表述為條件式自回歸圖生成:一個以任務 query 為條件的生成模型逐節點建構圖(自可擴充的 embedding pool 中為各 agent 選取角色,並發出 END token 以決定 agent 數量),再逐邊建構連結,並以 dense-to-sparse(先探索後追求效率)的 curriculum 進行端到端訓練,使生成的拓撲兼具正確性與 token 效率。

baselines_compared: Single-agent CoT, Self-Consistency, Chain, Tree, Complete graph, Random graph, LLM-Debate, AgentPrune, AgentDropout, G-Designer

key_improvements.en: With GPT-4o, ARG-Designer sets SOTA on all six benchmarks: MMLU 89.54%, GSM8K 94.40%, AQuA 86.45%, MultiArith 98.93%, SVAMP 95.63%, HumanEval 91.74%. Gains over prior SOTA G-Designer (86.92/93.80/81.60/96.50/93.10/88.33): MMLU +2.62, GSM8K +0.60, AQuA +4.85, MultiArith +2.43, SVAMP +2.53, HumanEval +3.41 (percentage points). vs AgentDropout: MMLU 85.62%, GSM8K 91.70%, AQuA 80.94%, MultiArith 95.60%, SVAMP 91.04%, HumanEval 85.98%. Token efficiency (GSM8K): ARG-Designer is the most token-efficient at 4.1e6 tokens vs G-Designer ~8.2e6 (~50% fewer).
key_improvements.zh: 在 GPT-4o 上,ARG-Designer 於全部六項 benchmark 皆達到 SOTA:MMLU 89.54%、GSM8K 94.40%、AQuA 86.45%、MultiArith 98.93%、SVAMP 95.63%、HumanEval 91.74%。相較先前 SOTA G-Designer(86.92/93.80/81.60/96.50/93.10/88.33),提升幅度為 MMLU +2.62、GSM8K +0.60、AQuA +4.85、MultiArith +2.43、SVAMP +2.53、HumanEval +3.41(百分點)。相較 AgentDropout:MMLU 85.62%、GSM8K 91.70%、AQuA 80.94%、MultiArith 95.60%、SVAMP 91.04%、HumanEval 85.98%。token 效率(GSM8K):ARG-Designer 最為節省,僅 4.1e6 tokens,而 G-Designer 約 8.2e6(約減少 50%)。消融實驗(於 MMLU/GSM8K/HumanEval 平均):完整模型 91.89;移除 fine-tune 為 91.28(-0.61);移除 task embedding 為 89.76(-2.13);移除 historical embedding 為 90.64(-1.25)。穩健性:於 prompt-injection 攻擊下的準確率下降最小(2.15%),優於固定拓撲。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Team composition (agent set), Roles / profiles
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: General-domain LLM MAS (not single-domain): six reasoning/math/knowledge/code benchmarks. Agents are GPT-4o instances, each assigned a role from an extensible role pool; the agent count is dynamic (decided by the END token during generation) rather than fixed. Agents communicate over the generated directed acyclic graph for K=3 rounds. External tools are not central — the contribution is the who-talks-to-whom spatial topology plus team composition. New roles can be injected at inference via metric-learning retrieval without retraining the generator.
agent_scenario.zh: 通用領域的 LLM MAS(非單一領域):涵蓋推理、數學、知識與程式碼共六項 benchmark。各 agent 為 GPT-4o 實例,並自可擴充的角色池中被指派角色;agent 數量為動態決定(於生成過程中由 END token 決定),而非固定。各 agent 於生成的有向無環圖上進行 K=3 輪通訊。外部工具並非核心——其貢獻在於「誰與誰對話」的空間拓撲以及團隊組成。新角色可於推論時透過 metric-learning 檢索注入,無須重新訓練生成器。
